title: chore: resync framework workflow to aidevops canonical caller
body:
## Summary

Resync `.github/workflows/issue-triage-gate.yml` to the canonical aidevops caller template
(reusable-workflow pattern, GH#20649 + GH#20727).

**Classification before**: `NO-WORKFLOW`
**Ref**: `@main`

## Why

The aidevops framework ships managed GitHub Actions workflows as reusable
workflows. Downstream repos carry ~45-line callers that delegate all logic
to the configured aidevops reusable workflow repository/ref.

This PR brings this repo in line with the canonical template, eliminating
drift and unblocking automatic updates when the framework evolves.

## How to verify

After merge, trigger an event matching the workflow triggers. Framework
scripts are fetched at runtime via a secondary checkout — no
`.agents/scripts/` files are needed in this repo.

## Rollback

If the workflow breaks, revert this PR. The previous workflow is preserved
in git history at the parent commit.

Generated by: `aidevops sync-workflows --apply` (see marcusquinn/aidevops#20649).

title: feat: point the agent at Ninja Forms' own abilities (#3003)
body:
Closes #3003

## Summary
Teaches the agent about Ninja Forms. Ninja Forms registers its own 32 `ninjaforms/*` abilities (create and edit forms, fields, actions, calculations, submissions, import/export, embed, settings), so this PR adds **no new form-creation ability**. It only makes the agent aware of them.

- `includes/Models/skills/contact-forms.md`: rewritten. Ninja Forms is the recommended plugin; the skill tells the agent to find `ninjaforms/*` with `ability-search` and run them with `ability-call`, lists the abilities by task, and records the rules the ability descriptions impose (merge-tag spacing, action field names, the two-step `remove-field` workflow and its confirmation phrase, export results being content not files, never printing secret settings, keeping children's data out of notification emails). `sd-ai-agent/create-contact-form` stays documented for WPForms, Contact Form 7 and the HTML fallback.
- `includes/Core/AbilityPluginRegistry.php`: Ninja Forms catalog entry (`ability_count` 32, `has_abilities` true); WPForms wording changed to "supported when already active".
- `includes/Automations/EventTriggerRegistry.php` + test: a "Ninja Form Submitted" automation trigger on `ninja_forms_after_submission`, registered only when Ninja Forms is active. This is the one addition that is not an ability; drop it if you would rather keep this PR to the skill and catalog entry.

`includes/Abilities/ContentAbilities.php`, its tests, `phpstan.neon` and the PHPStan stub from the first revision of this PR are reverted (no diff against `main`).

No identifiers were renamed.

## Tested through the agent (not just Ninja Forms directly)
Ran against real Ninja Forms 3.16.1 on WordPress 7.0 in wp-env (admin user), calling the agent's own entry points: `ToolDiscovery::handle_ability_search` / `handle_ability_call`, and `AbilityFunctionResolver::execute_ability()` with `FunctionCall` objects for the `wpab__sd-ai-agent__ability-search` / `ability-call` tool names. **65 of 65 checks passed** once the three opt-in abilities below were enabled.

- **Discovery:** all 32 abilities are visible to an admin and classified by the agent's permission model (27 auto-run, 5 destructive). Ten natural-language queries ("create a contact form", "form submissions", "embed form on page", ...) each surfaced NF abilities, and `select:` returns full input/output schemas.
- **Every ability executed through `ability-call`:** `create-form` (text, email, dropdown, textarea fields), `list-field-types`, `list-forms`, `get-form`, `add-field`, `update-field`, `reorder-fields`, `update-form`, `list-actions`, `add-action`, `update-action`, `add-calculation`, `update-calculation`, `list-calculations`, `duplicate-form`, `get-submissions`, `get-submission`, `get-submission-fields`, `update-submission`, `export-submissions` (CSV and JSON), `process-submission`, `export-form-definition`, `import-form`, `embed-form` (both steps, shortcode written to the page), `get-public-link`, `get-plugin-settings`, `update-plugin-settings`.
- **Confirmation gate:** `delete-action`, `delete-calculation`, `delete-form`, `delete-submission` and `remove-field` are refused with `ability_requires_confirmation` and succeed only after one-turn approval. `remove-field` returns Ninja Forms' export-first workflow and completes with the exact phrase from `next_step`.
- **Function-call envelope:** `ability-search` and `ability-call` work through the resolver, including an empty-args object, the `parameters` alias, a self-correcting `ability_invalid_input` error carrying the schema, and the destructive refusal.
- **Roles:** a subscriber and an editor neither see nor can run `ninjaforms/list-forms`.

Findings:
1. `ninjaforms/delete-form`, `update-submission` and `delete-submission` are marked `mcp.public = false` by Ninja Forms by default. The agent honours that: they are hidden from `ability-search` and `select:` (22 of the first 25 returned). A site enables one with the `ninjaforms_mcp_public_*` filters; I verified with a temporary mu-plugin that they then appear and pass the same checks. The skill now says so, so the agent does not work around it with `run-php`.
2. The harness is a one-off and is not committed: Ninja Forms is not installed in this repo's PHPUnit environment, so these checks cannot run in CI without new test infrastructure. Not done: a live model-driven chat (no provider credentials in the isolated environment); the checks exercise the same dispatchers the loop calls.
3. Ninja Forms itself logs PHP warnings (undefined keys in its email action) when `process-submission` is given a partial email setting; that is Ninja Forms code, not the agent path.

## Worker self-verification
- PHPUnit: Tests: 4819, Assertions: 23025, Errors: 0, Failures: 0, Skipped: 119, Incomplete: 1 (existing)
- Lint:    PHP clean (`composer phpcs`). JS and CSS lint, build and bundle budgets were last run on the first revision of this PR (all passed); this revision changes no JS, CSS or `build/` file (only PHP, one skill markdown file and a test).
- PHPStan: 0 errors
- Agent-path harness: 65 / 65 checks (see above)

## Notes
- WPForms support is untouched: other sites using this plugin may already run it.
- Consumer: the CEF chapter template now uses Ninja Forms only (superdav42/tgc.church#1416).

<!-- aidevops:sig -->
